label: Film Studio NEX-6
install_note: New package name, so it installs beside the a5100 Film Studio build. If the camera still returns to the native UI, copy /sdcard/FSNEX6/FSLOG.TXT back for diagnosis.
limitations: looks are live camera parameters (color mode, saturation, contrast, sharpness, WB, DRO), not the 3D LUT engine
settings are applied only while the app is open and restored on exit
center button or shutter saves the JPEG through the native camera; FSLOG reports whether a new DCIM file appeared
UI starts at the full panel; DELETE or SK2 cycles full -> pill -> hidden with the live view always visible
language_detection: Locale.getDefault(); zh-HK/zh-MO/zh-TW use the Traditional font, other zh the Simplified font
log_path: /sdcard/FSNEX6/FSLOG.TXT (8.3-safe directory; root FSLOG.TXT only as last-resort fallback)
